content: Enroll participants in care programs like diet/nutrition classes or wellness programs. Support electronic signatures and consent tracking per enrollment. Consent capture methods: in-person (tablet/mobile), remote (Experience Cloud site). Key setup: (1) Map external program enrollment fields to org fields using Care System Field Mapping. (2) Configure enrollment flows. (3) Set up consent documents per care program. (4) Register and ship healthcare devices for biometric tracking. (5) Configure consent forms on Experience Cloud sites for remote consent.
device_management: Register healthcare devices or create shipping requests. Care Coordinators track biometric data, identify healthcare gaps, and engage with patients for follow-ups.
gotchas: Care System Field Mapping must be configured before using the Enrollments API
Each mapping requires Label, Name, Source System, Target Object, External ID Field, and IsActive
Device registration and shipping are separate workflows from enrollment

content: Patient services program reps verify patient insurance and pharmacy benefit details. The platform provides agentic AI automation for benefits reverification: (1) Draft and send emails to patients with assessment URLs. (2) Patients submit updated personal, drug, pharmacy, provider, and insurance details via the assessment link. (3) Reps summarize and review responses comparing existing vs new information. Prebuilt flows automate various reverification tasks. The agent topic accelerates the reverification process by efficiently updating patient details.
prerequisites: Agentic AI licenses (Flex Credits Metering, Employee Agent, GPT Platform, Copilot, Prompt Builder)
gotchas: Currently English-only interface for the agentic features
Requires multiple AI-specific add-on licenses
Clone the default verification flow before customizing — do not edit the original

description: Care Programs provide structured patient support workflows. A Care Program defines the overall program; Care Program Products link eligible products; Care Program Enrollees track patient participation. Enrollment criteria can be automated via Flow or Apex triggers. Program types include patient assistance, adherence support, disease management, and outcomes tracking. Each enrollee has a care plan with milestones and tasks.
setup_steps: Create Care Program records with eligibility criteria
Link products to programs via CareProgramProduct
Configure enrollment workflows (manual or automated)
Set up care plan templates with milestones
Configure task assignment and escalation rules
gotchas: Enrollment criteria validation runs at enrollment time, not retroactively
Care plan templates are separate from the Care Program definition
Product eligibility must be configured per program
migration_relevance: Veeva patient programs map to Care Programs. Custom HUB implementations require careful object mapping.

description: Financial Assistance supports copay card programs, free drug programs, and patient financial aid. Benefits Verification Integration (BVI) checks insurance coverage and patient eligibility. HealthInsuranceBenefit and PharmacyBenefit objects capture coverage details. Prior Authorization workflow tracks approval status. The platform supports both manual and automated BVI through integration with pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs) and payers.
setup_steps: Configure financial assistance program types
Set up benefits verification integration endpoints
Configure prior authorization workflows
Set up copay card issuance and tracking
Configure payer-specific integration mappings
gotchas: BVI integration requires real-time connectivity to PBMs/payers
Prior authorization status must be tracked and expired authorizations flagged
Financial assistance eligibility criteria vary by program and must be configurable
migration_relevance: Specialized patient services capability. Maps to custom HUB/patient services implementations.

description: Intelligent Document Automation (IDA) extracts structured data from unstructured documents (prescriptions, insurance cards, lab results, enrollment forms). Uses OCR and AI-powered extraction to populate platform records. Document classification identifies document type before extraction. Extracted fields are validated against expected schemas before record creation. Supports batch processing for high-volume document intake.
setup_steps: Configure document type classifications
Set up extraction templates per document type
Configure field validation rules for extracted data
Set up batch processing for high-volume intake
Configure error handling and manual review queues
gotchas: OCR accuracy varies by document quality - build in manual review for low-confidence extractions
Extraction templates need document-type-specific configuration
HIPAA and data handling compliance requirements apply to all document processing
migration_relevance: Net-new AI capability. No direct Veeva equivalent.

description: Patient Program Outcomes track measurable results across the patient journey. Outcomes can be clinical (lab values, symptom scores), operational (time to enrollment, time to first fill), or financial (cost savings, reimbursement rates). Patient Timeline provides a chronological view of all patient interactions, treatments, and milestones. Timeline entries auto-populate from care program activities, prescriptions, and clinical encounters.
setup_steps: Define outcome measures and target values
Configure timeline data sources
Set up milestone tracking and alerts
Configure outcome reporting dashboards
Set up data aggregation for program-level analytics
gotchas: Timeline auto-population depends on proper object relationships being configured
Outcome measures must be defined before enrollment for baseline comparison
Program-level analytics require aggregation across individual outcomes
migration_relevance: Outcomes tracking may map to custom analytics implementations. Timeline is platform-native.

description: Electronic signatures capture patient consent, enrollment agreements, and authorization forms. Signature records link to the patient (Person Account), the document signed, and the timestamp. Touch-based signature capture works on mobile devices for in-person interactions. Signature images are stored as attachments. 21 CFR Part 11 compliance requires audit trails, unique user identification, and tamper-evident records.
setup_steps: Configure signature capture settings
Set up document templates requiring signatures
Configure audit trail settings for 21 CFR Part 11
Enable mobile signature capture for field teams
Set up signature verification and storage
gotchas: 21 CFR Part 11 compliance requires specific audit trail configuration
Signature images should be stored securely with tamper-evident controls
Mobile signature capture requires device-specific testing
Signature export for external systems must handle image format compatibility (3KB minimum gate for valid signatures)
migration_relevance: Veeva signature capture maps to Electronic Signature. CFR compliance requirements are similar but configuration differs.
